topics.title: Words in Context
topics.scope: A sentence or short text (1-3 sentences) with a blank or an underlined-style quoted word; choose the most logical and precise word or phrase. High-utility academic words, not obscure ones.

topics.title: Text Structure and Purpose
topics.scope: A short text of 60-130 words; ask for its main purpose, overall structure, or the function of one quoted sentence.

topics.title: Cross-Text Connections
topics.scope: Text 1 and Text 2 (each 50-90 words) on one topic; how would the author of Text 2 respond to a claim in Text 1, or how do they relate.

topics.title: Central Ideas and Details
topics.scope: A short text of 60-130 words; main idea or a supported detail.

topics.title: Command of Evidence
topics.scope: Which finding/quotation would best support or weaken a stated claim. About a third quantitative: use the `table` field (or describe a small data set in words) and ask which choice accurately uses the data to complete the text.

topics.title: Inferences
topics.scope: A short text ending in a blank; choose the choice that most logically completes the text.

topics.title: Boundaries (Punctuation)
topics.scope: Choose the punctuation that completes the text: commas, semicolons, colons, dashes, apostrophes, run-ons and fragments, restrictive vs non-restrictive clauses.

topics.title: Form, Structure and Sense
topics.scope: Subject-verb agreement, pronoun-antecedent agreement and case, verb tense and form, plurals and possessives, dangling and misplaced modifiers, parallelism.

topics.title: Transitions
topics.scope: Choose the most logical transition word or phrase; logical relationships: contrast, cause, addition, example, sequence, concession.

topics.title: Rhetorical Synthesis
topics.scope: A student's bulleted notes (4-6 bullets) and a goal; which choice most effectively uses relevant information to accomplish the goal.

topics.title: Reading Comprehension Passages
topics.scope: Sets: one original passage of 280-400 words (science, history, social science, arts, Pakistani or world settings) with 4 questions: main idea or summary, detail, inference, author's purpose or tone or vocabulary in context.

topics.title: Linear Equations in One Variable
topics.scope: Solving linear equations, including fractions and word problems; equations with no or infinitely many solutions.

topics.title: Systems of Linear Equations
topics.scope: Two equations in two unknowns, substitution and elimination, word problems, no-solution and infinite-solution conditions.

topics.title: Linear Functions and Graphs
topics.scope: Slope, intercepts, equations of lines from points, parallel and perpendicular lines, interpreting slope and intercept in context.

topics.title: Linear Inequalities
topics.scope: Solving and interpreting linear inequalities and systems of inequalities in context; absolute-value inequalities.

topics.title: Quadratic Equations and Functions
topics.scope: Factoring, the quadratic formula, sum and product of roots, discriminant, vertex form, maximum and minimum, modelling.

topics.title: Exponents, Radicals and Exponential Functions
topics.scope: Laws of exponents, fractional exponents, radicals, exponential growth and decay, percentage growth models.

topics.title: Polynomials and Rational Expressions
topics.scope: Expanding and factoring polynomials, remainder and factor theorem, simplifying rational expressions, rational and radical equations, absolute-value equations.

topics.title: Functions
topics.scope: Function notation, evaluating, composition, inverse, transformations, domain and range, functions given by a table.

topics.title: Logarithms and Sequences
topics.scope: Logarithm laws and equations (no calculator), arithmetic and geometric sequences and series.

topics.title: Ratios, Rates and Percentages
topics.scope: Ratios, proportions, unit rates, unit conversion, percentage change, successive discounts, mixtures, speed.

topics.title: Statistics
topics.scope: Mean, median, mode, range, effect of changing data, weighted averages, standard deviation (conceptual), sampling and inference from samples.

topics.title: Probability and Data Interpretation
topics.scope: Simple and conditional probability, two-way tables (use `table`), reading tables of data, counting.

topics.title: Area and Volume
topics.scope: Areas and perimeters of polygons, surface area and volume of prisms, cylinders, cones, spheres; scale factors.

topics.title: Lines, Angles, Triangles and Trigonometry
topics.scope: Angle facts, similar and congruent triangles, Pythagoras, special right triangles, sine, cosine and tangent, radians, trig identities and signs by quadrant.

topics.title: Circles
topics.scope: Arc length, sector area, radians, inscribed and central angles, tangents, the equation of a circle (completing the square).
